title: Build your first report
description: A four-minute tour of the Reports canvas. Skippable anytime.

steps.title: Welcome to Reports
steps.body: Reports lets you compose data-driven views without a BI license. Four minutes to see the essentials.

steps.title: Point the report at a data source
steps.body: Pick any source you have access to. Most first reports start with a saved query.

steps.title: Drop in a block
steps.body: Table, chart, or metric — every block is bound to the source you picked above.

steps.title: Preview before you publish
steps.body: Preview renders exactly what your viewers will see. Iterate freely — nothing is public yet.

steps.title: Ship it
steps.body: Publish makes the report visible to the audience you pick. You can unpublish anytime.
